designSourceOfTruth.rule: Production components and canonical design files are the source of truth. Screenshots and mockups are review evidence, never a parallel design system.

outcomeOrder: Understand the Local AI thesis and evidence-led method
experiencePriorities.conflictRule: When hierarchy conflicts arise, preserve thesis comprehension and evidence access before identity, promotion or advisory conversion.

desktop.layout: wide editorial canvas with evidence-led visual hierarchy

tablet.layout: stacked single column with preserved project context

mobile.layout: linear vertical experience, full readability, zero horizontal page overflow

typography.monoFont: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

home.progressiveDisclosure: thesis -> decision framework -> enabling infrastructure -> real product proof -> measured evidence -> identity/field notes -> advisory

methodPath.purpose: Narrative progress and spatial continuity between Decide, Build, Test and Measure.
methodPath.desktop: alternating left/right path with curved handoffs aligned to the current reading plane
methodPath.mobile: single vertical thread; readability has priority over preserving desktop curves
methodPath.reducedMotion: show a static guide and all content without scroll-coupled transforms
methodPath.javascriptFailure: show all content and local stage rails; the path may disappear but comprehension must remain intact
methodPath.resize: recalculate geometry after layout settles without losing narrative state

projectNavigation.desktop: archetype-specific navigation with no more than five primary items, project identity/status and one useful repository/demo action
projectNavigation.mobile: preserve compact project identity and horizontally scroll archetype-specific section navigation when necessary; active section remains visible and edge fades communicate overflow

adaptiveContent.tables: Prefer stacked labeled rows/cards below 640px when a comparison remains understandable without columns. Horizontal scrolling is a fallback, not the default.
adaptiveContent.code: Preserve code formatting in a keyboard-focusable horizontal scroller with an explicit mobile affordance; never create page-level overflow.
adaptiveContent.architectureDiagrams: Fit to container by default and allow explicit zoom for detail. Never rely on tiny embedded labels as the only explanation.
adaptiveContent.denseMetrics: summary first, then detailed diagnostics or tables; do not shrink meaningful text below 14px to preserve density.

projectPages.goal: Consistent comprehension across technical project deep-dives while letting each archetype follow the visitor's natural mental model.

rules.progressiveDisclosure: essential -> dominant visual/workflow -> context -> architecture/code/diagnostics -> evidence -> consequence

criticalJourneys.persona: Technical Decision Maker (CTO, CAIO, Head of AI)
criticalJourneys.flow: Hero (thesis & positioning) -> Decide (framework) -> Build (architecture) -> Measure (evidence) -> Discuss an AI architecture
Hero -> Applications (test beds) -> Observability (real run) -> Deep Dive Project Route / GitHub
Hero -> Systems -> About / Track Record -> LinkedIn / Get in touch
Seamless vertical journey without lost narrative state, unreadable microtype, broken SVG paths or hidden essential actions
Overview -> project-specific architecture/workflow/method -> technical depth -> evidence -> status/consequence -> related project or GitHub
